themeSummary: A character with an energetic vibe, featuring voluminous blue-green-white layered hair, a bright joyful expression with shimmering yellow temple markings, wearing an asymmetrical white-and-blue glowing crop top, a flowing green-and-blue pleated midi skirt, and simple pink glowing ballet flats.

hair.description: Voluminous, multi-layered spiky waves, styled to appear as if a cluster of light, with strands primarily in bright blue (#1a6fff), accented with green (#0a7d32) streaks and shimmering white (#f0f0f0) highlights, giving an ethereal glowing effect.

face.markings: Delicate, shimmering yellow cluster patterns near the temples
face.description: A bright, open expression with wide, sparkling eyes and a joyful, slightly mischievous smile, complemented by delicate, shimmering yellow (#ffe600) dots forming a 'cluster' pattern near the temples.

torso.style: Asymmetrical, layered crop top with jagged hemline
torso.description: A form-fitting yet flexible crop top featuring multiple overlapping, asymmetrical layers in crisp white (#f0f0f0), with vibrant blue (#1a6fff) accents peeking through, and a faint green (#0a7d32) glow emanating from the seams.

legs.description: A vibrant green (#0a7d32) midi skirt with irregular pleats that give it a clustered, layered appearance, featuring a subtle gradient into blue (#1a6fff) towards the hem, creating a light, airy movement.

shoes.description: Simple, glowing ballet flats in bright pink (#ff5ecb) with a single cluster-shaped gem on each toe.

theme_elements: Subtle green glowing seams on top
